core_relation.sentence: The truth of Christianity stands or falls on the historical fact of the resurrection, which is established by early, eyewitness-grounded testimony (homologia, creeds, Paul's conversion, and his Jerusalem verification) that collectively rules out legend or telephone-tag distortion.
core_relation.quote: If Jesus was raised from the dead, Christianity is true. [S006]

product_test.quote: If Christ is not been raised from the dead, let us eat and drink for tomorrow we die. [S674]
product_test.reason: The speaker frames the resurrection as a single load-bearing fact: if it is false, the whole edifice (Christianity, gospel, salvation) collapses, exactly like the zero-collapse of a multiplicative product. He repeatedly says 'you get the resurrection, it's game, set, and match' [S011] and 'Christianity is true' [S012], and quotes Paul's conditional collapse ('if Christ has not been raised... let us eat and drink') [S674]. The individual evidential lines (homologia, creeds, Paul's conversion, Jerusalem verification) each function as necessary factors: Habermas argues that if the chain were merely telephone-tag, the conclusion would fail, i.e., zero in any link zeros the result.

slots.plays_role: External negentropy influx — the revelatory act of God raising Jesus and appearing to witnesses, an outside source that grounds the whole chain and cannot be generated by the closed system of human reporting.
slots.quote: He meets Jesus and now magically all the creeds are true. Because he met the person about who whom these are about. [S297]

slots.plays_role: Alignment — Paul's Pharisaic training and his deliberate alignment with the Jerusalem pillars (Peter, James, John) to ensure his gospel matches theirs.
slots.quote: I went back up to Jerusalem to talk to the the big boys, the eyewitnesses, the leaders of the church, James and Peter, to make sure we're on the same page regarding the gospel. [S458]

slots.plays_role: Signal fidelity — the reliability of transmitted testimony through homologia, memorizable creeds, and eyewitness checks against noise/distortion ('telephone tag').
slots.quote: How do you know it's not phone tag, though? Here's the reason. [S358]

slots.plays_role: Effective entropy — the degradation of oral tradition over time (myth, legend, misconstrued data) that the early dating is meant to defeat.
slots.quote: You know how long it takes to make a myth? [S325]

slots.plays_role: Temporal integration — the tight chronology from the cross to Paul's conversion and Jerusalem visits (2–3 years, then 3 years, then 14 years) that accumulates consequence and prevents legend.
slots.quote: Here's the cross. Paul becomes a Christian either two or three. 3 years later he goes to Jerusalem. [S383]

slots.plays_role: Compression — the homologia/creeds as a memorizable kernel (sunflower seed) that compresses the gospel into transmissible form.
slots.quote: The kernel, the part you eat, is the homologia, but now a shell has been put around it. [S277]

slots.plays_role: Phase transition — Paul's conversion on the Damascus road as a discontinuous state change from persecutor to apostle.
slots.quote: Boom. He meets Jesus and now magically all the creeds are true. [S296]

slots.plays_role: Superposition — the open, unresolved possibility of what actually happened on Easter, held until it is actualized by eyewitness testimony and verification.
slots.quote: You tell me what you saw on Easter Sunday morning, and I'll tell you what I saw on the road to Damascus. [S446]

slots.plays_role: Non-local correlation — the shared, mutually confirming testimony of Paul, Peter, James, and John, whose independent accounts are correlated rather than independent.
Integration — the local integrator: Paul as the Pharisee-scholar who gathers, questions, and integrates the testimony of the eyewitnesses into a coherent gospel.
slots.quote: Paul's doing what Pharisees do. He's questioning Peter and James, and he says, 'Tell me if my gospel is correct.' [S465]

one_line: Habermas's argument is an analog of the master equation: the resurrection functions as a multiplicative load-bearing fact whose evidential chain (homologia, creeds, Paul's conversion, Jerusalem verification) must all hold, with T, K, E, S_eff, M, and C mapping directly and G, R, F mapping analogously, while Q is stretched.
breaks: The paper's argument is primarily evidential and historical, not a formal multiplicative law; the 'product' is rhetorical/conditional rather than mathematical.
Slot Q (superposition) is only weakly present: the paper treats the resurrection as a past fact to be established, not as an unresolved possibility held open until actualization.
Slot G is treated as a revelatory act rather than a measurable external negentropy source; the analogy is theological rather than physical.
The paper adds an 'emotional vs. factual doubt' distinction [S561, S571] that has no slot in the master equation.
The paper's '80% of creeds center on the gospel' [S606] is an extra quantitative factor not represented in the ten slots.
